Shimmer Pro Desk 4-in-1 Wireless Charger with Lamp, Clock & Pen Holder

Upgrade your workspace with the Shimmer Pro Desk 4-in-1 Wireless Charger, a premium multifunctional desk accessory designed for modern professionals, home offices, and smart workspaces. This innovative product seamlessly combines a wireless charger, pen holder, table lamp, and table clock into one compact and stylish unit, helping you stay organized, productive, and powered throughout the day.

The is engineered to deliver fast and reliable charging while enhancing the aesthetics and functionality of your desk. With support for Phone / Earphones / Watch, this all-in-one wireless charging station eliminates cable clutter and ensures your essential devices are always within reach and fully charged.

4-in-1 Smart Desk Solution

Designed for efficiency, this 4-in-1 wireless charger integrates a built-in desk lamp for optimal lighting, a clear digital display screen for time visibility, and a for convenient storage of stationery. Whether you are working late hours, attending virtual meetings, or studying, this multifunction desk organizer keeps everything you need in one place.

The supports multiple wireless output levels: 15W / 10W / 7.5W / 5W / 2.5W, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of devices. It is ideal for Android smartphones, iPhones, wireless earbuds, and smartwatches, making it a versatile for everyday use.

Equipped with a Type-C input and USB-C output, this wireless charger delivers stable power transfer, faster charging speeds, and improved energy efficiency. The advanced charging technology protects your devices from overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring safe and reliable performance.

Clear Digital Display & Built-in Desk Lamp

The integrated digital display screen offers a clear, easy-to-read interface that allows you to check the time at a glance. The feature is perfect for maintaining schedules and improving time management without the need for additional desk gadgets.

The built-in desk lamp provides soft, comfortable illumination that enhances visibility while reducing eye strain. Ideal for reading, writing, or working at night, the lamp adds both practicality and elegance to your workspace.

Smart Pen Holder & Desk Organizer

Stay organized with the integrated offering convenient storage space for pens, pencils, styluses, and small office essentials. This thoughtful design transforms the into a complete helping you maintain a clean and clutter-free desk.

Ideal for Office, Home & Gifting

With its sleek design and multifunctionality, this is perfect for offices, study tables, bedside tables, and corporate environments. It also makes an excellent choice for corporate gifting, promotional gifting, employee rewards, and festive gifts, offering both utility and premium appeal.

The is more than just a charging device—it is a smart workspace solution. By combining fast, organized storage, functional lighting, and a digital clock, it enhances productivity while maintaining a modern and professional desk setup. Built for convenience, safety, and style, it is the perfect addition to any contemporary workspace.
